text:
elaine: Hey team — bringing up tiny-reranker (distill-v2-int8). Offline: NDCG@10 down ~3.2% vs fp16 but MRR@1 up 1.8%. Anyone seen top1 up while tail drops?
ben: MRR up + NDCG down = top1 better but ranks 2..10 worse or ties moved.
priya: Check softmax/logit calibration preserved during quant. Float->int mapping can bias short docs.
kai: Also harness preproc changes can flip outcomes (truncation, html strip).
elaine: Harness used new truncation pass (strip html + collapse whitespace). Diff shows 1.2% queries had doc trimming differences.
ben: That could explain some, but 3% ndcg feels big. Paste eval command and an example?
elaine: Eval cmd: ./eval_rerank.py --model tiny-reranker-int8 --candidates candidates.jsonl --queries queries.jsonl --metrics ndcg@10,mrr@1 --seed 42
Example: query "how to configure sso" — fp16 top1 = doc_24 score 4.2 (gold), int8 top1 = doc_8 score 4.5 (shorter, stripped code), gold lost.
priya: Quant often amplifies token-level signals; short docs can win if early tokens dominate. Check tokenizer parity and logit stats.
elaine: Tokenizer parity ok. Logits: fp16 mean 1.8 std 0.9, int8 mean 2.1 std 1.05 — slightly higher mean/variance.
ben: Higher variance can widen gaps at top and compress mid ranks, hurting ndcg.
priya: Suggest metrics: stable_top1 (fraction top1==gold) and tail_ndcg (ndcg excluding top1 influence).
elaine: Quick numbers: stable_top1 +1.6%, tail_ndcg@10 -4.1% — top1 gain small group, tail loss widespread.
kai: Run bootstrap significance (10k) for both metrics; block if ndcg drop significant.
eval-bot: job 90321 started — will post stats when done. :robot_face: 
priya: Also run canonical candidate ordering (sort by doc_id before scoring) to remove harness non-determinism.
ben: Try affine calibration on logits (scale alpha, shift beta tuned on val) to recover tail.
kai: And a hybrid ablation: quantized weights but keep fp16 kv-cache/emb to see if embedding quantization causes bias.
elaine: Plan checklist: 1) bootstrap sig test, 2) canonicalization run, 3) logit affine sweep, 4) hybrid embed run, 5) re-run on common-gold-5k anchor.
priya: For anchor use common-gold-5k mapping we have. Also produce per-query diffs: fp16_top1_id vs int8_top1_id, tokenized lengths, truncation flag.
elaine: Posting small diffs (first 3): query "reset my password" fp16_top1 doc_112 len 280 truncated=false gold=true | int8_top1 doc_47 len 34 truncated=true gold=false; query "oauth callback error" both top1 doc_99 len 412 truncated=true gold=true; query "how to configure sso" fp16_top1 doc_24 len 520 truncated=true gold=true | int8_top1 doc_8 len 76 truncated=false gold=false.
priya: Pattern: int8 winners often short non-gold docs — supports short-doc bias hypothesis.
ben: If calibration fixes, add a quant-pipeline lint: fail quant if per-query logit-shift vs baseline > threshold.
kai: If bootstrap says ndcg not significant, we might accept tradeoff but document downstream impact.
elaine: Running canonicalization and calibration now. Will post eval-bot bootstrap results and diff outputs. Thanks. :thumbsup:
